title: Middle-earth: The Animated Films
blurb: The 1970s attempts at Tolkien: a Rankin/Bass Hobbit, Ralph Bakshi's unfinished Lord of the Rings, and a Return of the King that finishes the job.
note: Bakshi's film stops halfway through The Two Towers and its sequel was never made. Rankin/Bass's Return of the King was made as a sequel to their Hobbit, but it is the closest thing to an ending Bakshi's film has. The live-action films have their own page.
